steps.content:
02:13, August 26, N.F. 113
??, FAC Paradeisos Temporary Joint Operations Base, 
Special Observation Hall

This is a large trap meticulously set for the Garden's Mentor. Even during the heat of the August battle in the West District, Paradeisos chose a well-fortified location, equipped with abundant anti-Mania mechanisms, and the strongest HUSH elite squad. For a Sinner, this signifies the utmost form of respect.
But it's also completely meaningless.

steps.speaker: HUSH Combat Unit
steps.content: Argh—!

The attacker makes no attempt to hide. The assassin makes a grand entrance through the front door, turning the entire secret base into her hunting ground to trample at will. Screams echo everywhere. Everyone who can move, who dares to move, she eliminates them all.
Now, the Mentor slowly walks into the hall. She looks calm as she glances around.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: ...Where's your loyal dog? Did you purposely send her away to meet me?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Rahu? She is on a mission.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: There's still some cleanup work to be done for the operation, but I had an appointment with you first, so I left the rest to her. She has earned the trust of Paradeisos through reliable performance.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Huh, why send her away? It's so troublesome. I have to run around twice just to deal with two people.
Shalom watches her continue to approach. Schorl stands guard in front of Shalom, vigilantly sending out dense communication signals for backup. Energy is continuously gathering at its center.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>Her state has changed, X, back off. Your observation is still ongoing, you can't be damaged now.</color>
Shalom doesn't respond. She watches at the approaching blood-soaked Mentor, looking at her blood-red eyes.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: You seem quite calm.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: What kind of reaction do you expect from me? To cry my heart out? To break down? Haha, no. If something like this happens, they can only blame themselves.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: I've said it countless times, countless times. If you're not capable, don't take on big tasks. Protecting yourself is enough, I don't need your help.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: ...After saying all this, they still want to act like fools, what can I do? Just let it be, whether the flowers of the Garden live or die, they should be prepared.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Just... how old are you, Paradeisos girl? 25? 26? How many years has it been since you crawled out of the Paradeisos jar?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: You left me that kind of note... Are you trying to provoke me?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Are you underestimating me?
Four or five HUSH elites quickly sense the danger and rush to stand in front of Shalom. Then, a flash of red light, and they are instantly pierced through by Coquelic like a skewer.
Coquelic shatters all obstacles, charging straight towards Shalom, her eyes blood-red.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Who are you to play dirty with me?!
